item.text: [{"task_id":"d47aa2ff~v","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    blank = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    separator = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    removed = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    added = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    axis = int(round(params['layout'][0]))","    gap = int(round(params['layout'][1]))","    if axis not in (0, 1) or gap < 1:","        return grid.copy()","    work = grid.T if axis == 1 else grid","    cuts = np.argwhere(np.all(work == separator, axis=1)).flatten()","    if len(cuts) != 1:","        return grid.copy()","    cut = int(cuts[0])","    first = work[:cut]","    second = work[cut + gap:]","    if first.shape != second.shape:","        return grid.copy()","    changed = first != second","    result = first.copy()","    result[np.logical_and(changed, first != blank)] = removed","    result[np.logical_and(changed, second != blank)] = added","    return result.T if axis == 1 else result"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"layout":[2]},"params":{"colors":[0,6,2,7],"layout":[0,1]},"rationale":"Split the two snapshots at the magenta separator.
